justification: The only plausible correspondence is that both surfaces may carry a profile quadruped, which is about as generic as depicted content gets, and in A even that reading is uncertain from the faint pecked lines. B shows a fully developed, detailed scene of striding human figures leading horned rams beside a stylised tree over a rosette border, with dense patterned infill of fleece and beard, none of which has any counterpart in the sparse, isolated schematic outline of A.
